description: A four by four matrix of voltage-controlled amplifiers: each of four inputs can be sent to each of four outputs at its own level

params.text: Sets how much of that row's input reaches that column's output
Switches that crossing point off; each one comes up on, and its light shows the gain the crossing is passing

inputs.text: One of the four signals fed across the matrix
Sets the gain of that one crossing point, multiplying its knob; with nothing patched the crossing reads a fixed 5V, which is unity

outputs.text: The four inputs summed at the levels set down that column, clamped at 10V either way

notes: Every crossing point has its own CV jack, and an unpatched one is not silent: it reads 5V, so the knob alone sets the gain.
